sourceAndGame.meaning: Original archive/provenance losslessness is distinct from active-game geometry preservation. P0 clipping changes game components/holes and explicitly excludes original outside components; originals are not deleted or relocated. Operational cells use grid intersection and fixed numeric noding. A collapsed positive face can merge only within the same source partition/component across a verified shared edge with exact area preservation; unsupported raw positive faces remain diagnostic and fail certification. Zero source claim is country-residual, never an administrative fallback.
